goal: Extract scope/ + metric views from the fused component/+model/ layer (v3 redesign). Separate the scope/ownership model (Corpus->Realm->Package->Module->Class->Callable entity tree, identity, extent, carving) from the metric inventory (measures/metrics ABCs+records, model/ compute), which is relocated intact (home deferred to the linter-mechanics conversation). Target layering: span+identity primitives -> ast+lexicon kernels -> scope (region model + carve + analysis-context) -> metrics/{structural,lexical} -> linter. Hardening: (A) scope is a minimal region provider (id/kind/extent/nodes()/children/context; no per-view methods; View.over(region) owned by the view layer). (B) corpus-global graphs/indexes (class index, dep graph) move off entity attributes into a Corpus-held analysis-context reached via region.context. (C) ComponentId gains a stable logical key (kind+qualname) split from the volatile physical extent (additive). (D) metrics/ gets a Metric registry+descriptor; cross-family batteries are composite metrics, not rules. Guards: lexicon/ stays the standalone kernel (metrics/lexical is the slop signal layer above it, not a rename); metrics/structural consumes ast directly (no separate structural kernel); scope imports nothing from metrics/linter; metrics take (region,context) plain inputs, never scope objects. Naming: package scope/, root ABC Component->Scope. Staged additive-then-subtractive so the suite is green at every phase boundary (Phases: identity-low-base; metrics/structural additive; analysis-context+region protocol+lexicon projection inversion; rewire-then-sever rules; extract scope/ + re-point imports; prove granular scoping via Selection). Design doc: docs/.internal/design/SCOPE.md. Plan: ~/.claude/plans/silly-weaving-lovelace.md.

summary.title: Extracted scope/ + metric views from the fused component/+model/ layer (v3)
summary.what: Separated the scope/ownership model from the metric inventory and realized the layering span+identity -> ast+lexicon -> scope -> metrics/structural+graph -> linter. Staged additive-then-subtractive, green at every commit (71 tests). Phases: (1) extracted ScopeKind/ScopeId/Extent/CallableKind to slop/identity.py (low base) + added ScopeId.logical; (2) relocated the 13 metric records + 8 compute modules to metrics/structural/ (component.metrics shim); (3) moved class-index/dep-graph off entity attributes into a Corpus-held AnalysisContext reached via region.context, retired the provisional HasClasses (paradigm gating already via ast.Paradigm); (4) built the Structure view (Structure.over(region)), rewired the cyclomatic/call-islands rules onto it, migrated 11 metric test files, then removed every metric method + measure-ABC mixin from the entities (THE SEVER -- entities are now metric-free); (5) renamed package component/ -> scope/ and dissolved model/ into scope/ (concrete+carve+context+lexicon bridge) + graph/ (import extraction + dep-graph builder); (6) added Selection (a union of regions) proving granular scoping -- additive metrics sum over a union, lexicons combine. Then renamed Component/ComponentKind/ComponentId -> Scope/ScopeKind/ScopeId across the tree, and dropped the scope.metrics record shim. Boundary litmus verified: lexicon standalone; metrics/structural imports no scope/linter; scope imports no linter.
summary.why: component/ fused two concerns -- the ownership entity tree and the metric inventory -- by inheritance (Scope(ComplexityMeasures), etc.), so the entities both identified and measured. Severing them gives scope a single clear job (identify/locate/contain/project) and makes metrics a view consumed over a region, preventing the shared-responsibility coupling from spreading as the system grows.

decisions.chose: Isolate the scope entities; relocate the metric inventory intact, defer its final home.
decisions.rationale: Metric placement is entangled with the undecided linter-mechanics conversation; scope was decideable now.

decisions.point: Scope is a minimal region provider (hardening A)
decisions.chose: Scope exposes id/kind/extent/children/nodes/context + no per-view methods; views construct via View.over(region).
decisions.rationale: Keeps scope from becoming a hub coupled to every view; a new view touches zero scope code.

decisions.chose: class-index + dep-graph moved off entity attributes into a Corpus-held AnalysisContext reached via region.context.
decisions.rationale: Entities carry no metric-support state; new graphs add to the context without touching scope.

decisions.chose: ScopeId gained a logical key (kind+qualname) distinct from the volatile physical extent (additive).
decisions.rationale: Stops precluding caching / cross-run diffing without committing to incremental now.

decisions.chose: Consumer-driven: grew Structure to the full inventory because the migrated tests consume it; deferred the Metric registry (D) until config/docs need it.
decisions.rationale: Avoid unconsumed build-ahead while preserving the full inventory access.

decisions.chose: Renamed Component/ComponentKind/ComponentId -> Scope/ScopeKind/ScopeId (done last, after the user confirmed).
decisions.rationale: Initially kept Component to avoid a partial-rename inconsistency; the user chose the full rename, executed as a whole-word sweep.

rejected.alternative: Dissolve scope into the ast tree
rejected.reason: ast is per-file/forest-free by charter; Corpus/Realm/Package have no node, components span multiple files, and stable cross-reparse identity needs a layer above per-file ASTs.

rejected.alternative: Put the metric inventory under linter/
rejected.reason: It is the Structure view (twin of lexicon); folding into linter re-fuses metric and rule and breaks the lexicon symmetry. Home deferred, not decided as linter-internal.

rejected.alternative: Build the Metric registry + full facade up front
rejected.reason: No consumer yet; consumer-driven growth keeps unconsumed code out (registry deferred to when config/docs derive from it).

review_notes: Commits 039ca6c..549396a (Phases 1-6 + tidy + rename). 71 tests green at every phase boundary; additive-then-subtractive kept the accepted breakage off disk.
Mainline store drift: base_commit d6a80bd over-derives the prepared diff to 512 files; fingerprint below is hand-narrowed to the real scope-extraction footprint; fingerprint confidence lowered.

Residual: Module.imports() names the ImportDecl record (metrics.structural.records) -- a direct data-type reference, no shim, no cycle. The metric-home (structure/ peer vs linter-internal) is deferred to the linter-mechanics conversation. SCOPE.md may want a light naming refresh (it predates the Component->Scope rename).

architectural_claims: scope/ owns the ownership model (entity ABCs + concrete + carve + analysis-context + lexicon bridge); component/ and model/ are retired.
Scope entities are metric-free: structural metrics are taken over a region via metrics.structural.Structure.over(region), never component.metric().
Corpus-global indexes live in a Corpus-held AnalysisContext reached via region.context, not as entity attributes.
A Selection (union of regions) is itself a region; additive metrics sum and lexicons combine over a union, while altitude-bound metrics (CK/Martin) stay altitude-bound.

Layering span+identity -> ast+lexicon -> scope -> metrics/structural+graph -> linter is acyclic and litmus-verified (lexicon standalone; metrics/structural imports no scope/linter; scope imports no linter).

api_changes.signature: Component/ComponentKind/ComponentId renamed to Scope/ScopeKind/ScopeId; package slop.component -> slop.scope; slop.model retired

migration_notes: Deferred: the metric-home decision (metrics/structural as a peer view vs linter-internal); the Metric registry/descriptor (D) until config/docs consume it; an optional full ImportDecl/DependencyCycle relocation out of metrics into graph.
